reviews.text: Amanda took such great care of our cat while we were away for a few days! She was super communicative, texting when she arrived and throughout the visit. She even followed up once we got home to make sure everything was okay!
Amanda did a wonderful job taking care of our kitties! The daily updates were reassuring full of great pics! We came back after vacation to very happy cats and well maintained house as well :)

I can't recommend Amanda enough! She recently took care of my two cats, Sasha and Reds, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience.

From the very beginning, Amanda was kind, professional, and incredibly caring. She treated my cats like they were her own, and that gave me so much peace of mind while I was away. She sent me regular updates and pictures every day, which meant the world to me, especially since one of my cats, Sasha, has ongoing health issues. Seeing those daily updates helped ease a lot of my worries.

Amanda paid attention to the little things, too. She made sure they were fed, cleaned up after them, kept me informed of anything she noticed, and gave them plenty of love and attention during each visit. It was obvious from the photos and updates that both cats were comfortable with her and well cared for.

Her communication was outstanding, and she was always thoughtful, dependable, and compassionate. It's not easy trusting someone with your pets, especially when one has medical concerns, but Amanda exceeded every expectation.

I'm so grateful for the care she provided, and I won't hesitate to use her again in the future. If you're looking for someone who will genuinely care for your pets and keep you updated every step of the way, Amanda is the person to call. Highly recommend!

Amanda was amazing! We went out of town for a week and were so nervous about leaving our 2 dogs. One is pretty reactive and requires special care. They both did so well with Amanda! She gave us a lot of updates and when we got home our dogs were happy and relaxed and our home was in good shape

oh wow. amanda was everything i wanted in a pet sitter plus some! i own rats (i know, i know... pearl clutch somewhere else lol) who have difficult histories, and she was so gentle and consistent with them, and with me! live texts during her time dropping in to check on them, picture updates, behavioral status... like all of it. it really put me at ease to know my boys were so well taken care of while i was away, especially considering their unique needs. thank u so much amanda!

Amanda took care of our two fully flighted birds, a green cheek conure and a parakeet, for three days while we were gone for Christmas. We did a meet and greet beforehand, and I must admit I was anxious about leaving them with a stranger, but Amanda did an AMAZING job handling and caring for our birds! She is highly communicative and very professional. We will definitely be using her services again!!!

Highly recommend! Amanda was amazing with my pup and I would absolutely hire her again. She was responsive, attentive, and sent photos during the day as I asked. Thank you so much Amanda for taking such great care of her!!

Amanda impressed me at our first meeting by asking all the right questions—including ones no other sitter has asked. She knew how to get to know my kitty. And kept me completely updated on her visits. Very glad I found her!!!

Amanda is reliable, an excellent communicator and all around great sitter for my cat Mo, and dog, Grey! She follows all care instructions and provides detailed updates. I am able to enjoy stress free trips because I feel confident with my pets in Amanda’s care. So happy to have found her and highly recommend!

My cat (Abby) is very attached to me after my other cat passed. I hadn’t left her alone for about 9 months because I was just super nervous about making her feel sad and lonely. Which means I haven’t been able to travel. But I finally decided to reach out to someone so I can establish care with a new sitter. I found Amanda very easily after a quick Google search and contacted her. She got in touch with me right away, which soon led to a meet and great. She was very nice and Abby took to her right away. She asked all the right questions, and answered all of my (neurotic lol) questions with patience and understanding. I got a good vibe from her so I booked a weekend to try it out. I had her stay the whole weekend with Abby, and she was definitely at my place most of the time. She let me know when she was going out and when she was returning. It really gave me peace of mind. She sent me lots of updates and welcomed me to reach out as much as I wanted because she understood how nervous I was being away from my cat. When I got home Abby was very chill and happy, and my apartment was how I left it. There was even a small thing with my terrible landlord and she handled it with complete professionalism and patience. I would definitely have her stay with Abby again, and I would recommend her to anyone looking for pet care.

Amanda took amazing care of our three dogs during an overseas vacation.  She took great care of our dogs as well as our house, sending multiple pictures and updates of each dog every day.  We had no concerns while we were away.  We would highly recommend Panda's Petsitting to anyone searching for dog walker or sitter!

Can’t talk highly enough about Amanda & her business. Not only is she phenomenal with our temperamental, reactive pitty but she is also reliable and communicative. She was happy to work with our family and come for visits a few times before we left her with our dog & when she watched our girl, she always provided us with an overview of her visit, photo updates, and cares to follow up even after we are home to make sure our dog adjusted. Amanda has given us such peace of mind when we are away, which used to never be the case.
Amanda was a godsend when my dog sitter canceled their sit while i was out of town.  She did great with communication, my pets and was just wonderful.  Recommend.

Amanda is fantastic!! I’ve booked her a few times to watch my kitties for when I’m away on trips. She is always on time, reliable, and keeps me updated on her visits. Amanda gives a thorough report after her visits on their feeding habits, mood, playtime, and much more (with adorable pics). Her visits have given me peace at mind while I’m away, which I’ll definitely continue to book with her. Thanks for taking great care of my babies :)

I recommend Amanda for any pet sitting needs. It’s clear that Amanda takes pride in her company and the services that she provides. She’s communicative and thorough. When I’m away from home I have complete trust that Amanda will care for my …

Amanda is an incredible pet sitter! She is a former vet tech which helps me feel so much more comfortable leaving my older pets who need medications. She always gives regular updates with lots of pictures which is very comforting. So happy to have found her!

Amanda was awesome from the meet and greet to the care process to even checking in after our trip! She took care of our 10 year old cat, Taschy. Amanda came for 30 mins each day and took care of food, water, litter, pets, and playtime. She …
Love the daily updates! Amanda is so easy to work with and is really in tune with the animals she cares for.

We never worried once with Amanda housesitting for us and taking care of our 3yo pup. She was communicative throughout, arranged to pick up our dog from another sitter while we were away, and was flexible when our flight got delayed. Our dog loves her! Highly recommend!
Amanda is AH-MAZING.  Very communicative, flexible and loves my fur baby.  Will definitely use her services again in the future.
